title: Microsoft Purview: Classifier Simulation Mode for custom classifiers
summary: The briefing accurately reports Microsoft's rollout notice and roadmap targets, and its existing sensitive information type paths and PowerShell calls match Microsoft Learn. No blocking factual errors were found; the checklist mentions simulation and health insights without corresponding control rows.
